comps: Face-to-face: 3 pieces x 22 (fluency & accuracy 7, technical facility 7, communication & interpretation 8) = 66; technical work 14; supporting tests 20 (Initial-G5: any two of sight reading, aural, improvisation, musical knowledge, 10 each; G6-8: sight reading 10 + aural or improvisation 10); total 100. Pass 60-74, Merit 75-86, Distinction 87-100 (Below Pass 1: 45-59; Below Pass 2: 0-44). Per piece: Distinction 19-22, Merit 16-18, Pass 13-15. No need to pass every section. Digital technical-work pathway: 3 pieces x 22 = 66, technical work 14, overall performance 20 (=100); digital Repertoire-only pathway: 4 pieces x 25 = 100; same attainment bands. UCAS points G6 8/10/12, G7 12/14/16, G8 18/24/30 (Pass/Merit/Distinction).

Three pieces from the current repertoire list: two accompanied from Group A and one unaccompanied from Group B. At Initial-G3 one Group A piece may be a duet (upper part; duet part on a woodwind instrument, live or recorded). Own composition may replace a piece (accompanied -> Group A, unaccompanied -> Group B), comparable in demand (Initial 0.5-1 min up to G8 3.5-5 min; stave notation required G6-8; no marks for quality of composition). Flute, clarinet and saxophone candidates may swap one piece for a Jazz Woodwind piece listed for the same instrument, grade and group. Instrument rules: piccolo/alto flute, Eb/bass clarinet, cor anglais, contrabassoon only where listed (max one such piece); recorder G6-8 must play both descant and treble, only one piece on tenor/sopranino/bass; no plastic saxophones. Repeats over 4 bars not played; da capo/dal segno observed; no metronomes; memory optional (no extra marks). Accompanist supplied by candidate; backing tracks allowed to G3 face-to-face (live from G4), and at all grades digitally.

Digital exams (filmed, one continuous take, up to 3GB) offer two pathways: Technical work (3 pieces + scales/arpeggios Set A or B, or exercises, or G6-8 orchestral extracts/study, + overall performance mark) or Repertoire-only (4 pieces: at least two Group A and one Group B, 25 marks each).
